{{Quote|Light freighter ''Longshot'', this is the Galactic Alliance pursuit frigate ''Fast Death''. Respond immediately, or we ''will'' take measures to ensure that you do.|''Nargi''-class pursuit frigate ''Fast Death'', to Han Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
The '''''Nargi''-class pursuit frigate''' was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] for security and law enforcement. It had a double-nosed, sleek hull and was exceptionally fast, equipped with [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], two pursuit frigates attempted to apprehend [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] when he [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distracted]] Galactic Alliance forces [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], smuggled four [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Planet/Legends|offworld]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Nargi''-class pursuit [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was a long and sleek [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. It was double-nosed and had a sleek, [[Color/Legends|blue]] hull. The ''Nargi''-class frigate was also equipped with large [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]], and was known to be exceptionally fast.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Role==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Longshot'', your evasive action has been noted. We are now declaring you a ''suspect vessel in flight''. If you continue on this course, we ''will'' apprehend you forcibly.|''Fast Death'' command, to Han Solo in the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
The ''Nargi''-class frigate was used by the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances<ref name="Abyss" /> around [[43 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third instalment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> Often called simply "Galactic Alliance pursuit frigates," they were stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they were used for pursuit of vessels that broke Coruscant's flight regulations, as well as general security and law enforcement. ''Nargi''-class frigates also had the authority to declare vessels suspect, as well as take such vessels into custody by force.<ref name="Abyss" />

==History==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Quick End'' command to the ''Star Princess''&mdash;or whatever you're calling yourself at the moment. Have you lost your ''kriffing'' mind, Solo?|''Quick End'' command, to Han Solo in the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Exilecropped.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Han Solo (right) distracted ''Nargi''-class pursuit frigates so Leia Organa Solo (left) could smuggle psychotic Jedi off of Coruscant.]]
The Galactic Alliance first used ''Nargi''-class pursuit frigates sometime after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In 43.5 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> when several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to develop a [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]], the Galactic Alliance [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encase]] all of the affected [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. The [[New Jedi Order]] resented this and hid as many of the psychotic Jedi as possible in the [[New Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant, but to prevent [[Galactic Alliance Security]] from discovering them there, they decided to transport these Jedi [[Planet/Legends|offworld]].<ref name="Abyss" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], whose task was to [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distract]] Galactic Alliance forces in orbit over Coruscant, flew in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], breaking every procedure for departing the planet. He was confronted by two ''Nargi''-class frigates, the ''[[Fast Death]]'' and the ''[[Quick End]]''. Solo eventually faked a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] explosion off the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} stern, spiraling toward the ''Quick End'' and declaring an out-of-control emergency. The ''Quick End'' maneuvered out of his way, and, finally convinced that Solo wasn't trying to pull a trick, the ''Nargi''-class frigates broke off their pursuit. While the pursuit frigates and other orbital forces were sidetracked, Solo's wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], smuggled the psychotic Jedi offworld.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nargi''-class pursuit frigate appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
